titles.th: หนุ่มสามัญกับสาวหลุดโลก

1.overview: Niwa Makoto has moved to a new town to live with his aunt while his parents are away on business.  He believes he will be living alone with her but upon arriving finds a rolled up futon with legs sticking out of it.  His aunt dances around the issue and it is left to Makoto to make contact with “it”.
1.summary:
When Niwa Makoto`s parents moved overseas, they decided he would move to the city and stay with his aunt, Towa Meme. Makoto was told that Meme is unmarried and childless, but when he arrives, he finds a mysterious girl wrapped up in a futon...
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 失踪する思春期のレヴェリー

2.overview: After successful contact with Touwa Erio the self-professed alien wrapped in a futon Makoto attends his first day of school.  He meets Ryuko Mifune in his class and rides his bike home with her.  The next day he encounters Maekawa a tall girl who becomes dizzy if she holds her arms above her head for more than 10 seconds.  That night after taking Erio to the beach they run into Maekawa who recognizes Erio as a former student who had disappeared for six months.
2.summary:
Erio, despite her beautiful appearance, is a strange girl who believes herself to be an alien. One night, Erio asks to be taken to a distant beach, where Makoto learns about the incident that caused Erio to begin calling herself an alien.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 地を這う少女の不思議な刹那
title.en: A Strange Moment for a Girl Bound to the Ground
title.x-jat: Chi o Hau Shoujo no Fushigi na Setsuna

3.overview: Makoto spends the day with Mifune.  Later his aunt Meme tells him not get involved with Erio.  The next day at school Makoto debates what to do about Erio and decides that he can’t help her recover her memories from her six month disappearance but he can help convince her that she is not an alien.  He decides to prove once and for all that Erio can’t fly.
3.summary:
Makoto is irritated by Erio`s attempt to escape reality by making herself believe that everything was done by aliens. He wants to have her accept reality. However, Meme sits down with Makoto and tells him to just leave Erio alone.
Source: Funimation

4.overview: Turns out Makoto can’t fly either and ends up breaking his arm in the process.  While he stays in the hospital he is visited by Mifune and Maekawa who come to find out why he rode his bike off a cliff.  When he returns home aunt Meme wants to take him and Erio out to celebrate his return.
4.summary:
Makoto broke his right arm while partaking in an "adolescent" activity and has been stuck in the hospital since. Erio doesn`t come to visit Makoto, but his female classmates Ryuuko and Maekawa-san manage to swing by...
Source: Funimation

title.ja: サンクスギビングの憂鬱

5.overview: In her usual dramatic fashion Meme has a midlife crisis about turning 40.  She decides to have a birthday for Eiro the next day since she forgot about it last year.  Eiro tells Makoto she wants to reenter society and get a job.  Being such a well-known weirdo around town the only place she can get a job is in the small store run by an equally old lady.
5.summary:
Meme grows desperate and crazed upon her 40th birthday. Erio gives her a gift, which spurs her on to celebrate Erio`s birthday the next day, since they skipped it when it actually came about. Erio tells Makoto she wants to rejoin society.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: リュウ『コ』さんの, なんちゅーか, もやーっと

6.overview: Ryūko goes with her friend to the Tamura shop, where she encounters Erio and also spots Makoto. The next day, she decides to visit the place, running into Meme along the way. Afterward, Ryūko talks to Makoto about the bad reputation Erio has at school, mentioning it may cause him troubles if he is seen hanging out with her. Later, Makoto asks the old lady for some advice on the matter. A few days later, Ryūko and Maekawo visit the Tōwa household, where Makoto has trouble keeping Erio under control. As Meme returns and the suggests the girls stay for dinner, she openly hints that Ryūko might be a match for Makoto.
6.summary:
Ryuuko rediscovers Erio`s infamy. She is worried that Makoto might get ostracized at school because of Erio`s past. Also, Maekawa-san decides to visit Makoto`s place. Ryuuko, who has conflicted feelings for Makoto, begins to show signs of irritation...
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 誰かさんの思い出になる日
title.en: A Day Someone Ought to Remember
title.x-jat: Dareka-san no Omoide ni Naru Hi

7.overview: Maekawa is confused by an anonymous person leaving soft drinks outside of the sweets store she works at, suspecting someone who launches bottle rockets nearby. She later meets with the culprit, who claims to be a fan of hers and commissions her to make more bottle rockets. She accepts the job, asking Makoto, Erio and Ryūko to help out. After they each make some rice bowls for dinner, Erio invites Maekawa and Ryuko to stay for the night, where Ryuko mentions to Makoto about it being her birthday the next day and how she'd take his side if it came down to people picking on Erio. The next day, they go to the beach where they join the bottle rocketeer in launching their bottle rockets.
7.summary:
One month ago, Maekawa-san received five plastic soda bottles When she confronts the man who gave them to her, he asks Maekawa-san to build plastic bottle rockets for him. After being told that he would pay 5,000 yen per rocket, Maekawa-san accepts.
Source: Funimation

title.ja: ツィオルコフスキーの祈り

8.overview: The episode focuses on Meme during the events of the previous weeks. On June 12th, she gets a bottle rocket tested out by the bottle rocketeer, who suddenly asks her to marry him. Whilst avoiding him for a week, Meme recalls 28 years ago when she first met Elliot, the boy who would become Erio's father. Meme later visits the rocketeer to refuse his proposal, later learning he had mistaked Maekawa for Erio whilst trying to woo Meme with his rockets. Meme then convinces her granny to accompany her for the launching of the bottle rockets at the beach, pitching the whole thing as an attack on aliens.
8.summary:
After thinking really, really hard, Meme decides to cheer her ailing mother up by making plastic bottle rockets. She soon encounters the man who asked Maekawa-san to make rockets. It turns out he is Meme`s childhood friend. She makes a certain request...
Source: Funimation

9.overview: Maekawa invites Makoto to join in a game of baseball with various other people. Later that night, Makoto goes stargazing with Erio. She joins in the match the next day, where they meet a strange person dressed as an astronaut claiming to be an Esper.
9.summary:
It`s summer vacation! Not really having much else to do, Makoto accepts an invite to play baseball with Maekawa-san. After one game, Erio hears about Makoto`s summer antics playing baseball and insists that she wants to play, too...
Source: Funimation

10.overview: Makoto and Erio continued to be bothered by the spacegirl, who later introduces herself as Yashiro Hoshimiya. Later that night, Ryushi calls Makoto about her upcoming basketball game, asking him to accompany her to the festival if she is able to play in it. The next day, Meme has Makoto take Yashiro back to her place, stopping by a pool along the way.
10.summary:
The city`s baseball team roster includes a self-proclaimed psychic/alien named Yashiro. At night, Yashiro comes out from under the Towa`s house in full astronaut gear. Erio charges at her while inside her trusty futon, knocking Yashiro`s helmet loose...
Source: Funimation

title.ja: 今年の夏はバスケと超能力と布団と天体観測と祭りと野球と女々(めめ)たんと
title.en: This Summer Is Basketball, Psychic Powers, Stargazing and More - Plus Meme-tan!
title.x-jat: Kotoshi no Natsu wa Basket to Chounouryoku to Futon to Tentaikansoku to Matsuri to Yakyuu to Meme-tan to

11.overview: Maekawa invites Makoto over to her house for lunch, where he spots Yashiro lurking in her garden. The next, Ryuko invites Makoto to watch her basketball match where she meets her friend, Miki, and also runs into Yashiro again. As Ryuko struggles in her match, Yashiro encourages Makoto to cheer for her, giving her the confidence to score some points.
11.summary:
Makoto is invited to lunch at the Maekawa residence. While playing games with Maekawa-san, Makoto is told that he`s "good at giving up on things" by Maekawa-san. This revives sour memories. Then, Makoto goes to a basketball game to cheer on Ryuuko, but...
Source: Funimation

12.overview: On the day of the baseball match, Maekawa's father runs away due to pressure, leaving the shopping district team shorts on pitchers. With Meme declaring herself coach, she sends Makoto to search for Maekawa's father whilst Erio pitches. After returning with Maekawa's father, Makoto is made the pinch hitter. As he makes a powerful hit, a strong wind kicks up, turning it into a home run. As a reward, Meme kisses Makoto on the cheek in front of everyone.
12.summary:
The shopping center`s baseball team and the city`s team schedule a match to decide who may host the festival. As the head coach for some reason, Meme decides to sub Erio in as the pitcher. Meanwhile, Makoto must seek out Maekawa-san`s AWOL father...
Source: Funimation

S2.summary:
Makoto goes to the festival with Ryuuko. Makoto gets to the shrine where Erio is waiting and is greeted by Yashiro, who claims she will demonstrate a small part of her psychic powers and tells Makoto to take three steps back. She raises her left arm...
Source: Funimation
